databricks.label: Databricks
databricks.note: Days 1-14 on the Databricks 14-day trial, then Databricks Free Edition

features.title: Scan rush hours with time_bucket
features.summary: Buckets a store day of grocery scans into 30-minute slots aligned to the 07:15 opening, with scan counts and health scores per slot.
features.headline: Busiest slot 12:15 · 6 scans · 13 slots

features.title: One-pass category scorecard with WHERE inside aggregates
features.summary: Grocery category scorecard (Nutri-Score A/B, high-risk additives, organic vs conventional) computed in a single BigQuery pass.
features.headline: Organic scores +32.7 points · 7 categories

features.title: Lane counters with counter_diff
features.summary: Turns reboot-prone cumulative checkout-lane scanner counters into items scanned per lane, skipping resets.
features.headline: 4,964 items · 4 resets handled · naive total 10,443

features.title: Grading grocery predictors with ML.METRICS
features.summary: Scores the organic label as a health predictor and the Nutri-Score letter as a score estimate, with no model, in BigQuery.
features.headline: Organic → healthy F1 0.60 · Nutri-Score R² 0.98

features.title: Barcode audit with a Unity Catalog Python UDF
features.summary: A governed Python UDF (named handler, environment 6) checks every scan's GS1 check digit and counts bad barcodes per checkout lane.
features.headline: 12 of 240 scans invalid · self-checkout 10.9%

new_feature.name: Scalar Unity Catalog Python UDFs with named handlers (GA)

features.title: What moved this week's grocery sales? AI.KEY_DRIVERS
features.summary: Compares this week's units with last week's across every store, category and channel segment in one BigQuery call and finds what drove the change.
features.headline: Units +2.5% · north produce −430 · online bakery +368

features.title: Rolling grocery sales with metric view window measures
features.summary: A Unity Catalog metric view defines prior-7-day, trading-day and month-to-date measures once in YAML and flags promo spikes per store.
features.headline: 22,139 units MTD · 3 promo spikes · closed day handled

features.title: When did oat-milk sales shift? ML.DETECT_CHANGE_POINTS
features.summary: Finds the window where each store's daily oat-milk sales shifted, over every series in one BigQuery call with no model.
features.headline: East +55% from 2026-07-10 (end-cap) · west no shift

features.title: Fiscal-week sales on a numeric index metric view
features.summary: Week-over-week, prior-4-week and to-date grocery sales from metric view windows on a dense fiscal-week number, straight across the fiscal year end.
features.headline: 2 promo weeks flagged · FY27 W01 vs FY26 W52 · 74,222 units

new_feature.name: Window measures on numeric index columns in metric views

features.title: Which weekday sells the most bread? ML.SEASONALITY
features.summary: Separates each store's weekly bread pattern from its trend in one BigQuery call with no model, to set per-weekday bake plans.
features.headline: North peaks Sat +57 loaves · south Fri +37

features.title: Re-load a corrected scan export with INSERT ... REPLACE
features.summary: Replaces one store-day of grocery scans atomically with INSERT INTO ... REPLACE USING, and shows why REPLACE ON with <=> is the idempotent choice when a key can be NULL.
features.headline: North Oct 2: 6 → 4 lines · REPLACE ON rerun-safe, REPLACE USING not

new_feature.name: INSERT INTO ... REPLACE USING / REPLACE ON (Databricks SQL 2026.32)

features.title: Is oat milk growing, or just noisy? ML.TREND
features.summary: Pulls each store's oat-milk trend out of noisy, weekend-heavy daily sales in one BigQuery call with no model, classifies it growing / flat, and projects it 14 days ahead.
features.headline: North growing +3.4/wk · south flat +0.3/wk

features.title: Which shelf tags to reprint? Automatic change data feed
features.summary: Reads every price change on a row-tracking table with table_changes(), without ever enabling change data feed, and turns it into a shelf-tag reprint list.
features.headline: 3 reprints, 1 new, 1 removed · no enableChangeDataFeed needed

features.title: Did the shelf reset move sales? AI.CAUSAL_EFFECT
features.summary: Measures the effect of a shelf reset on three products' daily sales with one AI.CAUSAL_EFFECT call: an ARIMA_PLUS counterfactual and a p-value per product.
features.headline: Kombucha endcap +42% · oat milk bottom shelf -30% · sparkling water no effect

features.title: Cut-to-the-cent unit-price labels: truncate and trim_array
features.summary: Prints unit prices per 100 g with the new truncate() (toward zero, no rounding) and voids the last N scans of a basket with the new trim_array().
features.headline: Rounding would overstate 6 of 10 unit prices · truncate never does · 4 baskets voided with trim_array

new_feature.name: truncate and trim_array SQL functions (Databricks SQL 2026.38)

features.title: Product keys BigQuery generates: identity columns
features.summary: A product master with GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY keys: load, add only the vendor feed's new items, refuse a hand-written key, and key the scan facts.
features.headline: 10 products keyed from 1000 in steps of 10 · 2 new from the feed · hand-written key refused

features.title: Which saved report queries still parse, and what they read: parse_sql
features.summary: Parses eight saved grocery report queries with the new parse_sql() without running them: flags the ones that no longer parse and maps which tables each one reads.
features.headline: 3 of 8 saved report queries no longer parse · 5 tables read · scans feeds 4 reports

features.title: How much will a new item sell? Zero-shot AI.PREDICT with TabFM
features.summary: Forecasts weekly units for 8 new grocery items from 48 known ones with BigQuery's TabFM through AI.PREDICT: no model trained or stored, scored against held-out sales.
features.headline: 8 new items forecast zero-shot · TabFM MAE 11.4 vs least squares 17.3 vs naive 214.0 units/week

features.title: Out-of-stock substitutes with the NEAREST BY join
features.summary: Finds the two closest in-stock substitutes for each out-of-stock grocery item with the new NEAREST BY join: one join with a mismatch score instead of a cross join, a window and a filter.
features.headline: 5 out-of-stock items · 2 substitutes each · 5 same-category first choices · 1 second choice from another category

features.title: Promo-aware strawberry forecast: TimesFM 3.0 with a future covariate
features.summary: Forecasts 14 days of daily strawberry sales with BigQuery AI.FORECAST and TimesFM 3.0, passing the planned promo calendar as a future covariate: zero-shot, no model stored, scored against held-out sales.
features.headline: 14-day forecast · promo calendar cuts TimesFM 3.0 MAE from 18.6 to 8.6 units/day (68.2 to 17.4 on promo days)

features.title: Delivery radius with an ST_DWithin spatial join
features.summary: Finds every household within 2.5 km of each grocery store with one spatial join ON st_dwithin over st_makepoint points, then reports coverage, overlap and gaps.
features.headline: 39 of 60 homes within 2.5 km of a store · 10 with a choice of stores · 21 outside every radius

new_feature.name: ST_DWithin spatial join condition and st_makepoint (Databricks SQL 2026.15)

features.title: Scan anomalies with TimesFM 3.0 in AI.DETECT_ANOMALIES
features.summary: Checks four weeks of daily scan counts for three grocery staples with BigQuery AI.DETECT_ANOMALIES and TimesFM 3.0 in one zero-shot query, and scores it against three planted problems.
features.headline: 84 store-days · TimesFM 3.0 flagged all 3 planted problems (scanner outage, duplicate scans, short delivery) · 0 false alarms

features.title: Lane device network audit with the new IP address functions
features.summary: Matches 40 checkout devices to their store's IPv4/IPv6 subnets with try_ip_host, ip_version and ip_cidr_contains, and flags devices in the wrong store, on an unknown network or with a bad address.
features.headline: 34 of 40 devices on their own store's network · 2 in the wrong store · 2 on unknown networks · 2 bad addresses

new_feature.name: IP address functions: try_ip_host, ip_version, ip_cidr_contains (Databricks SQL 2026.20)

features.title: Forecast accuracy with TimesFM 3.0 in AI.EVALUATE
features.summary: Backtests 14-day zero-shot forecasts for three grocery items with BigQuery AI.EVALUATE, TimesFM 3.0 next to TimesFM 2.5, and compares both with a seasonal-naive baseline.
features.headline: 3 items x 14 held-out days · TimesFM 3.0 beat seasonal naive on all 3 (bananas MAE 6.0 vs 9.9) and TimesFM 2.5 on 2 of 3

features.title: Basket and aisle allergens with collect_union
features.summary: Rolls per-product allergen arrays up to 12 shopping baskets and 5 aisles with the new collect_union aggregate, flags baskets with nuts and nut-free aisles, and checks it against array_distinct(flatten(collect_list(...))).
features.headline: 2 of 12 baskets allergen-free · 5 contain nuts · gluten in 8 baskets · 3 of 5 aisles nut-free

features.title: Store-day KPIs with multi-level aggregation
features.summary: Computes average daily revenue, best day, weekend-day revenue, basket value and size, and a per-SKU average shelf price for three stores in one BigQuery GROUP BY, using aggregates of aggregates such as AVG(SUM(revenue) GROUP BY sale_date).
features.headline: 3 stores x 14 days · Riverside weekend lift +68% · plain AVG over the join misstates shelf price by up to $1.33

features.title: Current shelf prices and aisle top sellers with QUALIFY
features.summary: Turns 87 shelf-tag price changes into each store's current price (with change count and previous price) and picks the top 2 sellers per aisle, each with a QUALIFY instead of a subquery; checked against plain Python and the same query in DuckDB.
features.headline: 87 tag rows → 33 current prices · 12 of 24 latest changes were cuts · P07 spread 120¢ · produce tie kept by RANK

features.title: What drives ice cream sales, with ML.CORRELATION
features.summary: Correlates daily ice cream revenue with temperature, promotion depth and foot traffic for 3 stores and overall, Pearson and Spearman, with ML.CORRELATION and no model; checked against pure Python. Found that the Spearman rollup row ranks within each store rather than over all rows.
features.headline: Lakeside r=0.96 with temperature · Downtown r=0.96 with promotion · Campus r=0.91 with foot traffic · pooled weather only 0.48

features.title: Re-stage a corrected supplier cost file with CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE
features.summary: Stages a supplier cost file and its corrected re-delivery in a session-local temporary table, replaced in one statement inside a single SQL script, then flags SKUs under a 25% margin with a suggested price; checked against plain Python and the same statements in DuckDB. First Free Edition day.
features.headline: 11 staged rows replaced by 12 · 3 costs corrected · 7 of 12 SKUs under 25% margin · first file would have got 2 flags wrong

new_feature.name: CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE (Databricks SQL 2026.15)

features.title: One freshness check for every feed, with an ANY TABLE table function
features.summary: One table-valued function with an ANY TABLE parameter checks late-arriving rows per store against each feed's SLA, called on three feeds with different columns (scans, deliveries, shelf-tag prices) in a single multi-statement query; checked against plain Python and a DuckDB table macro.
features.headline: 1 function · 3 differently shaped feeds · 14 of 129 rows late · S3 deliveries 5/5 late, up to 521 min

new_feature.name: ANY TABLE parameters in table-valued functions (GA)

features.title: Flyer drop zones with st_makeenvelope
features.summary: Builds five flyer zones with st_makeenvelope from corner pairs typed in any order and joins 80 households with st_contains; flags a zone that collapsed to a line and homes that get two flyers. Checked against plain Python and a DuckDB box filter.
features.headline: 34 flyers · 31 of 80 homes reached · 3 get two (overlap) · reversed corners handled · 1 zone collapsed to a line
